recipes.title: Chicken beef pho instant pot
ingredients: Pho spice bag: 1 black cardamom pod (3g)
Pho spice bag: 2 tbsp fennel seed (10g)
Pho spice bag: 2 tbsp coriander seed (10g)
steps: Char the ginger and yellow onion.
Add the beef shank, beef bones, charred ginger and onion to the Instant Pot with 10 cups of water, sugar, and salt.
Add the pho spice bag (cinnamon, star anise, black cardamom, fennel seed, coriander seed, clove).
Add the chicken bouillon and fish sauce.
Pressure cook on high for 45 minutes.
